عمرو بن شعيب بن محمد بن عبد الله بن عمرو

notes: The braces «{ عن أبيه، }» repeat the same words as an editor's insertion, so the father is written once.
«قالوا يا رسول الله الفرع» — the speakers are a group in the scene; the last links are the father (relation) and Zayd b. Aslam, alternatives at one level.
